title: 5K Pace Calculator
description: Turn a 5K goal time into pace per km, per mile and a full kilometer-by-kilometer split plan.
howto: Enter your 5K goal time in minutes and seconds.
Read your required pace per km and per mile.
Follow the km-by-km split table on race day.

faqs.a: Beginners often run 30-35 minutes; regular runners 22-28; competitive club runners go sub-20. Your first goal should be beating your own best.

faqs.q: How do I hit these splits?
faqs.a: Practice goal pace in training with intervals (e.g. 5 × 1 km at goal pace). Start the race slightly conservatively.

faqs.q: Why is the mile pace slower than the km pace number?
faqs.a: A mile (1.609 km) is longer than a kilometer, so it takes more time at the same speed.
